nodes.description: ERC20Upgradeable._name storage variable holding the token name set during initialize
ERC20Upgradeable._symbol storage variable holding the token symbol set during initialize
ERC20Upgradeable._totalSupply storage variable increased by _mint and decreased by _burn
ERC20Upgradeable._balances mapping of account balances written by _transfer, _mint and _burn
ERC20Upgradeable._allowances nested mapping read and written by transferFrom/burnFrom and _approve
AccessControlUpgradeable._roles mapping plus _roleMembers set backing MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
PausableUpgradeable._paused flag toggled by pause/unpause and checked in _beforeTokenTransfer
OwnableUpgradeable._owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier that guards _authorizeUpgrade
Initializable._initialized flag that prevents initialize from being called twice on the proxy
uint256[50] private __gap reserved storage in BNKToken and inherited upgradeable bases to preserve layout
ERC1967 _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT which stores the implementation address written during upgrades
initialize(string,string) initializer of BNKToken that sets token metadata and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE
decimals() override returning 8 instead of the ERC20 default of 18
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override guarded by onlyOwner; the single access-control gate for UUPS upgrades
mint(address,uint256) public function requiring MINTER_ROLE before calling _mint
pause() public function requiring PAUSER_ROLE before setting _paused to true
unpause() public function requiring PAUSER_ROLE before setting _paused to false
ERC20 transfer(address,uint256) that moves tokens from _msgSender() via _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint256) that moves tokens using the allowance mechanism and decrements allowance in an unchecked block
ERC20 approve(address,uint256) that writes _allowances through _approve
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal routine that validates addresses/balance, updates _balances in an unchecked block and fires Transfer
_mint(address,uint256) internal routine increasing _totalSupply and _balances with no supply cap
_burn(address,uint256) internal routine reducing _balances and _totalSupply
_beforeTokenTransfer hook overridden by ERC20PresetMinterPauserUpgradeable and ERC20PausableUpgradeable to revert while paused
UUPS upgradeTo(address) external onlyProxy that calls _authorizeUpgrade then _upgradeToAndCallSecure
UUPS upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) payable onlyProxy that authorizes the upgrade then delegatecalls attacker-supplied data
ERC20Burnable burn(uint256) that destroys tokens held by _msgSender()
ERC20Burnable burnFrom(address,uint256) that destroys tokens using the caller allowance
AccessControl grantRole(bytes32,address) restricted to the role admin, writes _roles and _roleMembers
AccessControl revokeRole(bytes32,address) restricted to the role admin, removes membership
Ownable owner() view used by the onlyOwner modifier
AccessControl hasRole(bytes32,address) view reading _roles[role].members[account]
msg.sender as returned by ContextUpgradeable._msgSender(); the caller-controlled identity used for every role and allowance check
delegatecall performed in ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall / _upgradeToAndCallSecure with an arbitrary target and calldata
unchecked block computing currentAllowance - amount in ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom and ERC20BurnableUpgradeable.burnFrom
unchecked block computing senderBalance - amount inside _transfer
unchecked block computing accountBalance - amount inside _burn before _totalSupply -= amount
string memory name parameter of initialize
string memory symbol parameter of initialize
address to parameter of mint, the beneficiary of newly created tokens
uint256 amount parameter of mint, the quantity of tokens created
address sender parameter of transferFrom, the account debited
address recipient parameter of transferFrom, the account credited
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom, also used to reduce the allowance
address account parameter of burnFrom, the account whose tokens are destroyed
uint256 amount parameter of burnFrom
address newImplementation parameter of upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall that becomes the delegatecall target
local variable currentAllowance read from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom
local variable senderBalance read from _balances[sender] in _transfer
local variable accountBalance read from _balances[account] in _burn

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to _msgSender() and must hold MINTER_ROLE for mint to succeed
msg.sender must hold PAUSER_ROLE before pause can freeze transfers
msg.sender must hold PAUSER_ROLE before unpause can resume transfers
_authorizeUpgrade is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with _msgSender()
transfer passes _msgSender() to _transfer as the debited account
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed
burn destroys tokens from the _msgSender() account
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE to _msgSender()
initialize is protected by the initializer modifier which reads and writes _initialized
initialize sets the initial entries of _roles and _roleMembers through _setupRole
owner() returns the _owner state variable that the onlyOwner modifier compares against
the onlyOwner modifier on _authorizeUpgrade depends on owner() returning _msgSender()
hasRole reads role membership from the _roles mapping
grantRole writes role membership into _roles and _roleMembers
revokeRole removes role membership from _roles and _roleMembers
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade
upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade
upgradeTo reaches the delegatecall in _upgradeToAndCallSecure/_functionDelegateCall; a mis-guarded authorizer yields full takeover
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls caller-supplied data against the new implementation after authorization
the rollback test delegatecalls upgradeTo(address) on the newly installed implementation, re-entering _authorizeUpgrade mid-upgrade
mint calls _mint(to, amount) after the MINTER_ROLE check
_mint reached from mint increases _totalSupply with no cap, so a compromised or malicious minter can inflate supply
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer before reducing the allowance
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before increasing supply
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before decreasing balances
ERC20PausableUpgradeable._beforeTokenTransfer requires !paused(), reading the _paused flag
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient]
the unchecked block of _transfer performs senderBalance - amount without overflow checks
transferFrom updates the _allowances mapping through _approve
the unchecked block of transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount after a require guard
the unchecked block of _burn computes accountBalance - amount before _totalSupply -= amount
_burn decreases _totalSupply, an unchecked rebalance of the supply
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount

normalization_plan.reason: the name parameter only exists to seed _name through __ERC20_init_unchained called by initialize
the symbol parameter only exists to seed _symbol through __ERC20_init_unchained called by initialize
the to address is only consumed by mint when forwarding to _mint
the amount is only consumed by mint when forwarding to _mint
sender is only consumed by transferFrom for the balance debit and allowance lookup
recipient is only consumed by transferFrom when forwarding to _transfer
amount is only consumed by transferFrom for the allowance require and unchecked decrement
account is only consumed by burnFrom for the allowance lookup and _burn call
amount is only consumed by burnFrom for the allowance require and _burn call
newImplementation is the delegatecall target consumed by upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall after _authorizeUpgrade
currentAllowance is the term of the unchecked currentAllowance - amount subtraction that motivates the unsafe-operation node
senderBalance is the term of the unchecked senderBalance - amount subtraction inside _transfer
accountBalance is the term of the unchecked accountBalance - amount subtraction inside _burn
